create_descriptor_pool: create a DescriptorPool instance to dynamically register and look up protocol buffer descriptors at runtime
add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorPool so its message types become available for lookup
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name in the DescriptorPool
find_extension_by_number: find an extension field descriptor by its field number for a given message descriptor
find_all_extensions: find all registered extension descriptors for a given message descriptor in the pool
